title: Roll with $62 and multiple hotel threats
description: Roll with $62 and multiple hotel threats. Cash is too low to pay voluntarily into a dangerous board. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: I'll try my luck and roll for doubles.
final_action.private_thought: I have $62 cash and a $50 fine. Paying would leave me with only $12, limiting future flexibility. Rolling for doubles costs nothing and gives a 1/6 chance to exit jail and keep cash. If I fail, I stay in jail this turn but retain cash for later decisions. Given my low cash and no houses, preserving cash is preferable. I'll attempt to roll for doubles.
